description: This file defines the 'Ingredient' interface for a recipe application, including functions for JSON serialization/deserialization and type checking. It references external models 'Food' and 'Unit'.

methods.name: instanceOfIngredient
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the Ingredient interface.

methods.name: IngredientFromJSON
methods.description: Creates an Ingredient object from a JSON value.

methods.name: IngredientFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Creates an Ingredient object from JSON with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: IngredientToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an Ingredient object to JSON.
